source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC WebUI to set Last state, reboot BMC and verify persistence, then perform separate AC removal/restoration while SUT is On and while SUT is Off.
source_snapshot.criteria: Policy remains unchanged; previous On returns On after AC, and previous Off remains Off after AC.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes unverified `PowerRestorePolicy=AlwaysAck` as last-state and operator AC work. `AlwaysAck` is not the DMTF ComputerSystem enum, and the suggestion omits protected mapping, original-policy recovery, branch isolation, full feed loss, BMC persistence, stop-on-first-failure and complete On-branch boot recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly preserves both conditional branches with exact enum validation, staged authorization, workload/PDU safety, independent state observation and final recovery.

old_problem: LastState is a conditional policy and cannot be proven by one readback or one AC cycle. The DeepSeek enum is unsupported, and the prior record kept Pending for property mapping, target/feed identity and the two safe physical scenarios. DMTF now supplies the authoritative LastState semantic; remaining values are bounded Project execution inputs.
disposition_reason: Use target-advertised ComputerSystem.PowerRestorePolicy=LastState—not guessed `AlwaysAck`—and preserve the Master as two separately authorized physical AC branches. First prove persistence through BMC-only reboot; then prove On→On with automatic boot through OS Ready, and independently Off→Off with no automatic host start. The exact System/WebUI mapping, all-feed PDU topology, branch timing and recovery are versioned runtime requirements, not unresolved engineering design.
decision_basis: XLSX row 981, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 982 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 982 / variant e36dd0e53b4d6189.

DMTF defines ComputerSystem.PowerRestorePolicy=LastState as returning to the On or Off state held when power was lost. It does not define `AlwaysAck`; that review-layer value is rejected unless an approved OEM mapping explicitly maps it to standard LastState.

Both source branches are required and have opposite results. The On branch needs actual automatic boot and OS Ready; the Off branch must prove no host boot during the observation window. Evidence cannot be shared between branches or borrowed from AlwaysOn/AlwaysOff variants.
BMC reboot, graceful host shutdown used to establish Off, physical AC loss and later recovery power-on are distinct transitions with separate approvals and evidence.

ED-06, ED-08, ED-15, ED-17, ED-18, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve transition/variant identity, actual WebUI/physical evidence, logs and recovery; ED-33 through ED-38 allow parameterization while requiring human AC action, staged confirmation and no retry.

test_case.test_name: Verify LastState persistence and separate On-to-On and Off-to-Off behavior across true AC loss
test_case.purpose: Verify standard LastState is correctly mapped in the actual BMC WebUI/ComputerSystem resource and persists through BMC-only reboot, then in two isolated human-controlled AC scenarios returns a previously On host automatically through OS Ready and keeps a previously Off host Off, followed by safe final policy and platform recovery.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/ComputerSystem/Manager/firmware/WebUI identity and target-advertised writable PowerRestorePolicy with standard LastState support or approved UI/OEM-to-standard mapping
Captured original policy and owner-approved final policy/power/workload state
Complete PSU/feed/PDU/outlet/cable topology proving true external AC loss and preventing impact to shared/neighbor equipment
Two isolated branch runbooks in source order: verified On/workload-drained pre-state and verified Off pre-state, with independent BMC/PowerState/console/POST/OS Ready observations
Maintenance window, BMC reboot/graceful shutdown methods, per-stage/branch timeouts, AC-off dwell, no-boot observation interval, expected event allowlist and incident recovery
Pinned reviewed Script, protected API/WebUI access, actual rendered WebUI capture, human AC operator/observer and explicit approval before each mutation/branch
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Discover the exact ComputerSystem, verify advertised LastState support and reject unapproved `AlwaysAck`. Preserve original policy, current state/workloads/health, SEL/audit logs and actual WebUI setting. With explicit approval set LastState through the approved protected interface, verify API and rendered WebUI, then with separate approval reboot only the BMC/Manager, wait for readiness, rediscover resources and verify persistence. Branch A (On→On): separately approve, drain workloads as required, prove host On/OS Ready, have a human verify exact feeds/outlets, remove every required AC feed for the approved dwell and restore them; without manual power-on, verify automatic PowerState progression, POST and OS Ready/service health. Stop all work if Branch A fails. Branch B (Off→Off): after separate approval use the approved graceful method to establish/prove host Off, perform a new independently evidenced complete human AC loss/restore, then verify the host remains Off with no boot throughout the observation interval while BMC recovers. Preserve expected/unexpected logs without clearing. Finally, separately approve restoration of the original/final policy and, if required, manually power on and verify OS Ready. Never substitute BMC reboot, DC cycle, one-feed interruption or one branch for the other; never retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: LastState is accepted, read back and shown in actual WebUI and remains configured after BMC-only reboot. In Branch A, the independently proven On state is restored automatically after true AC return and completes POST to OS Ready/service health without manual power-on. In Branch B, the independently proven Off state remains Off for the entire post-AC observation while BMC management recovers and no host boot occurs. Both branches have correct expected events and no residual faults, and the approved final policy/state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires standard LastState/property mapping, original-policy capture, protected set/readback and actual WebUI evidence, persistence after distinct BMC reboot, plus separately complete human AC evidence for On→automatic On→OS Ready and Off→remains Off. One branch, policy readback, `AlwaysAck` without mapping, BMC reboot, host reboot, DC cycle, single-feed interruption or AlwaysOn/AlwaysOff evidence cannot pass. Wrong prior-state restoration, unexpected boot/no-boot, incomplete feed loss, wrong target/outlet, abnormal logs/health or failed final recovery is FAIL; failure of Branch A stops Branch B. Missing runtime mappings/timers is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require explicit approval immediately before policy write, BMC reboot, each branch's pre-state transition and each physical AC operation; reverify exact SUT/BMC/PDU/feed identity each time.
Physical AC handling is human-only and must remove all approved target feeds without affecting shared equipment; the agent must not operate or infer PDU/cord state.
Branch A requires workload drain/backup/recovery readiness before abrupt AC loss; Branch B requires independently proven Off before its separate AC cycle.
Do not run Branch B after any Branch A anomaly, ambiguity or incomplete recovery; preserve evidence and escalate instead.
Capture original policy and tested recovery paths before mutation; preserve SEL/audit/PDU/console/OS evidence and never clear logs.
Stop on enum/property mismatch, wrong outlet, incomplete isolation, lost observation, unexpected power state/alarm or recovery failure; do not automatically repeat either branch.
expected_evidence: Staged approvals, immutable System/Manager/PDU/feed identity, original/final policy and separate branch runbooks
Protected LastState write/readback, approved UI mapping and actual rendered WebUI captures before/after BMC reboot
BMC-only reboot readiness, resource rediscovery and policy persistence artifacts
Branch A independent On baseline, human complete-AC record and no-manual-trigger PowerState/POST/OS Ready/service-health timeline
Branch B independent Off baseline, new human complete-AC record and bounded proof the host stayed Off while BMC recovered
Per-branch expected/unexpected logs, stop/abort audit, restored final policy/state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any branch anomaly, stop the matrix immediately and keep all feeds in the owner-defined safe state. Use the approved console/BMC/PDU incident process without another automatic cycle. Once stable and separately authorized, restore the original/final policy and desired host state, verify BMC plus OS Ready/services if On is required, preserve all evidence and escalate failures.

source_conflict.reason: Master clearly requires standard LastState and both conditional outcomes. DeepSeek's `AlwaysAck` is rejected as unsupported review guidance rather than accepted as a competing source.

blocked.reason: DMTF defines LastState and both outcomes. Exact target mapping, feed topology, maintenance/timers and recovery are finite Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Actual System/Manager/LastState/UI mapping; original/final policy; complete feed/PDU map; isolated On/Off branch baselines; BMC/AC/boot/no-boot timers; event allowlist; WebUI/Script/console/recovery runbook.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO POLICY WRITE, BMC REBOOT, HOST/AC/DC/POWER ACTION, WEBUI, PDU OR DUT TEST EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Defines ComputerSystem.PowerRestorePolicy LastState as returning to the last On or Off state when power is applied, plus PowerState semantics.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Normatively defines LastState and schema discovery; it provides no standard `AlwaysAck` enum.

project_authority: The Project owner binds standard LastState to the exact WebUI/System implementation and supplies full feed topology, safe isolated branch sequencing, timers, logs and recovery. These versioned inputs make both conditional outcomes executable without new semantic invention.
